dbQuery.query: SELECT CODE "CODE", UPPER(description) || CASE WHEN ANOMALY_REFERENCES IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || UPPER(ANOMALY_REFERENCES) ELSE '' END "EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION" FROM sgio_ili_anomaly_type_cl
SELECT ROUTE_ID "ROUTE_ID" FROM sgio_ili_inspection i WHERE ILI_INSPECTION_ID = {ILI_INSPECTION_ID}

dbCommand.query: UPDATE sgio_ili_data SET anomaly_extension_cl = COALESCE((SELECT a.code FROM sgio_anomaly_extension_cl a JOIN sgio_ili_anomaly_type_cl b ON a.code = b.index_description WHERE b.code = sgio_ili_data.anomaly_type_cl),'UNKNOWN') WHERE sgio_ili_data.ili_inspection_id = {ILI_INSPECTION_ID}
UPDATE sgio_ili_data SET weld_number = NULL WHERE weld_number = '' AND ili_inspection_id = {ILI_INSPECTION_ID}

UPDATE sgio_ili_data SET us_weld_distance = absolute_odometer - us_weld_odometer, ds_weld_distance = ds_weld_odometer - absolute_odometer WHERE ili_inspection_id = {ILI_INSPECTION_ID} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sgio_ili_data ddd JOIN sgio_ili_data ww ON ww.ili_inspection_id = ddd.ili_inspection_id AND ddd.absolute_odometer >= ww.absolute_odometer AND ww.absolute_odometer >= ddd.absolute_odometer - 100 WHERE ww.ili_inspection_id = {ILI_INSPECTION_ID} AND ww.anomaly_type_cl = 5001 AND ddd.ili_data_id = sgio_ili_data.ili_data_id )

data.comment: Insert pipe lengths from weld data

dbCommand.query: INSERT INTO sgio_ili_pipe_length(ili_inspection_id, weld_number, sequence_number, start_odometer, end_odometer, measured_wall_thickness, nominal_wall_thickness, source_gcl) SELECT ili_inspection_id, weld_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY absolute_odometer), absolute_odometer, LEAD(absolute_odometer) OVER(ORDER BY absolute_odometer), measured_wall_thickness, nominal_wall_thickness, source_gcl FROM sgio_ili_data d WHERE ili_inspection_id = {ILI_INSPECTION_ID} AND anomaly_type_cl = 5001

INSERT INTO sgio_ili_inspection( begin_date, end_date, tool_type_cl, model, ili_comments, tool_vendor_cl, description, comments, route_id, source_gcl ) VALUES ( '{DATE}', '{DATE}', 'UNKNOWN', '{MODEL}', '{FORMAT}', '{COMPANY}', '{KM_START}-{KM_END}', -- ПРИМЕЧАНИЕ: В оригинальной PostgreSQL-схеме pods.line — родительская сущность для pods.route -- (иерархия: трубопровод -> маршрут). Здесь используем pods_route.description напрямую, -- так как таблица pods_line отсутствует в SQLite-схеме. -- В SQLite-схеме первичный ключ pods_route называется id (не route_id). (SELECT COALESCE(r.description, 'Unknown route') FROM pods_route r WHERE r.id = {ROUTE_ID} LIMIT 1), {ROUTE_ID}, '{REPORT_NAME}' )

INSERT INTO sgio_ili_data( ili_inspection_id, weld_number, absolute_odometer, average_depth, length, width, internal_external_cl, source_gcl, date_collected, orientation_deg, anomaly_type_cl, anomaly_extension_cl, measured_wall_thickness, feature_description, description, milepost, nominal_wall_thickness, comments, us_weld_odometer, ds_weld_odometer, us_weld_number, srv_district_gcl, x_coord, y_coord ) VALUES ( {ILI_INSPECTION_ID}, '{WELD_NUMBER}', NULLIF(REPLACE('{ABSOLUTE_ODOMETER}', ',', '.'), '') + 0, NULLIF(REPLACE('{AVERAGE_DEPTH}', ',', '.'), '') + 0, NULLIF(REPLACE('{LENGTH}', ',', '.'), '') + 0, NULLIF(REPLACE('{WIDTH}', ',', '.'), '') + 0, 'UNKNOWN', '{SOURCE_GCL}', '{DATE}', ROUND(NULLIF(REPLACE('{ORIENTATION_DEG}', ',', '.'), '') + 0), CASE WHEN '{SOURCE}' = 'WLD' THEN 5001 ELSE (SELECT MIN(CODE) FROM sgio_ili_anomaly_type_cl t WHERE UPPER(',' || COALESCE(t.description, '') || ',' || COALESCE(t.anomaly_references, '')) LIKE '%' || REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM('{ANOMALY_TYPE_CL}')), '*', '%'), '?', '%') || '%') END, 'UNKNOWN', NULL, '{FEATURE_DESCRIPTION}', '{DESCRIPTION}', '{MILEPOST}', NULLIF(REPLACE('{NOMINAL_WALL_THICKNESS}', ',', '.'), '') + 0, '{COMMENTS}', NULLIF(REPLACE('{US_WELD_ODOMETER}', ',', '.'), '') + 0, NULLIF(REPLACE('{DS_WELD_ODOMETER}', ',', '.'), '') + 0, NULLIF(REPLACE('{US_WELD_NUMBER}', ',', '.'), '') + 0, {SRV_DISTRICT_GCL}, NULLIF(REPLACE('{X}', ',', '.'), '') + 0, NULLIF(REPLACE('{Y}', ',', '.'), '') + 0 )

dbQuery.query: SELECT ili_data_id "ILI_DATA_ID", absolute_odometer "ABSOLUTE_ODOMETER", calibrated_measure "MEASURE", control_point_lf "CONTROL_POINT_LF", certainty_interval "ACCURACY", NULL "EVENT_ID" FROM sgio_ili_data d WHERE d.ili_inspection_id = {P_REPORT_ID} AND absolute_odometer IS NOT NULL ORDER BY absolute_odometer

dbCommand.query: UPDATE sgio_ili_data SET calibrated_measure = {MEASURE}, srv_district_gcl = {SRV_DISTRICT_GCL}, x_coord = {X}, y_coord = {Y}, z_coord = {Z}, tube_height = {DEPTH}, station = {STATION}, pipe_measure = {MEASURE} WHERE ili_data_id = {ILI_DATA_ID}

data.comment: Get pipe length data for coordinate update

dbQuery.query: SELECT p.ili_pipe_length_id "ILI_PIPE_LENGTH_ID", p.weld_number "WELD_NUMBER", NULL "EVENT_ID", d1.x_coord "X_COORD", d1.y_coord "Y_COORD", d1.ds_weld_distance "ODOM_LENGTH", d2.pipe_measure - d1.pipe_measure "LENGTH", d2.x_coord "NEXT_X_COORD", d2.y_coord "NEXT_Y_COORD" FROM sgio_ili_pipe_length p JOIN sgio_ili_data d1 ON p.ili_inspection_id = d1.ili_inspection_id AND p.weld_number = d1.weld_number AND d1.anomaly_type_cl = 5001 JOIN sgio_ili_data d2 ON p.ili_inspection_id = d2.ili_inspection_id AND p.weld_number = d2.us_weld_number AND d2.anomaly_type_cl = 5001 WHERE p.ili_inspection_id = {P_REPORT_ID} ORDER BY d1.absolute_odometer

dbCommand.query: UPDATE sgio_ili_pipe_length SET x_coord_start = {X_COORD}, y_coord_start = {Y_COORD}, x_coord_end = {NEXT_X_COORD}, y_coord_end = {NEXT_Y_COORD} WHERE ili_pipe_length_id = {ILI_PIPE_LENGTH_ID}

dbQuery.query: SELECT ili_data_id "OBJ_ID", absolute_odometer "LINE_COORD", CASE WHEN d.anomaly_type_cl IN (1003,1007,1008) THEN '1' WHEN d.anomaly_type_cl=1004 THEN '2' END "OBJ_CLS_ID" FROM sgio_ili_data d WHERE d.ili_inspection_id = {P_REPORT_ID} AND d.anomaly_type_cl IN (1003,1004,1007,1008) ORDER BY absolute_odometer

dbCommand.query: UPDATE sgio_ili_data SET ref_event_id = NULL, control_point_lf = 'N', calibrated_measure = NULL, certainty_interval = NULL WHERE ili_inspection_id = {P_REPORT_ID} AND COALESCE(ref_event_id, 0) != -999

dbQuery.query: SELECT ROUTE_ID "ROUTE_ID" FROM sgio_ili_inspection i WHERE ili_inspection_id = {INSPECTION_ID}

data.comment: Load route geometry WKT for JS processing
Load all markers for reper matching

dbQuery.query: SELECT id "STATION_ID", station "STATION", AsText(Geometry) "GEOM" FROM pods_marker WHERE Geometry IS NOT NULL

data.comment: Load all valves for reper matching

dbQuery.query: SELECT id "ID", AsText(Geometry) "GEOM" FROM pods_valve WHERE Geometry IS NOT NULL

SELECT ili_data_id "ILI_DATA_ID", calibrated_measure "CALIBRATED_MEASURE", x_coord "X_COORD", y_coord "Y_COORD", station "STATION", ref_event_id "REF_EVENT_ID" FROM sgio_ili_data WHERE ili_inspection_id = {P_REPORT_ID} AND ref_event_id = -999 AND calibrated_measure IS NOT NULL

data.comment: Update a single control point after reper linking

dbCommand.query: UPDATE sgio_ili_data SET ref_event_id = {FACILITY_ID}, control_point_lf = 'Y', calibrated_measure = {MEASURE}, certainty_interval = {COEFF} WHERE ili_data_id = {REPER_ID} AND COALESCE(ref_event_id, 0) != -999
